institutional_core.mission: Prepare, qualify and train ministry and mission personnel for diplomatic, consular and international-cooperation work while supporting research, analysis and consultation.
institutional_core.governance: A formal administrative unit within Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
institutional_core.programme_model: Courses, training sessions and special qualification programmes for MFA personnel and representative missions.
institutional_core.learning_model: Practical and theoretical capacity development linked to diplomatic and consular work.
institutional_core.research_model: The Institute is mandated to prepare studies and research on diplomacy, international political and economic relations and regional/international issues.
institutional_core.professional_practice_model: Training is directly tied to ministry, mission and diplomatic-consular operational roles.
institutional_core.international_cooperation_model: The Institute may cooperate with universities and similar institutes inside and outside Qatar and participate in international meetings and seminars.
institutional_core.digital_transparency_model: Official MFA pages describe mandate, governance, director and contact details.
